edits.text: The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 650,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s normal payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to senior executives of the Company, on terms no less favorable than those applicable to similarly situated executives, subject in each case to the terms and conditions of such plans and applicable law.
edits.name: Base Salary and Benefits

edits.text: Upon termination of the Executive’s employment by the Company without Cause, or by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall be entitled to: (i) continued payment of base salary for twelve (12) months following the termination date; (ii) a pro rata annual bonus, if any, earned through the termination date; (iii) continued Company-paid health coverage for up to twelve (12) months to the extent permitted by law; and (iv) immediate vesting of any time-based equity awards scheduled to vest during the twelve (12) months following the termination date, subject to the terms of the applicable award agreements. As a condition to receiving severance, the Executive shall execute and not revoke a customary release of claims, and comply with the post-employment obligations set forth in this Agreement.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: The Executive shall not engage in a competitive business, or directly solicit the Company’s employees or material customers, for a period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment, in each case only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law and only as reasonably necessary to protect the Company’s confidential information and legitimate business interests. If a court of competent jurisdiction determines that any restriction in this Section is overbroad, the parties intend that it be modified to the minimum extent necessary to be enforceable.
edits.name: Non-Compete and Protection Scope

edits.text: The Executive’s duties shall be consistent with the position of Chief Operating Officer and shall include such responsibilities as are reasonably assigned by the Company, provided that any material diminution in title, authority, or reporting relationship shall constitute Good Reason if not cured within the applicable notice and cure period.
edits.name: Good Reason Protection
